meta_description: Bedminster Locksmith offers emergency electrical work across Bristol. Fast response, fully insured, and local expertise. Call us now for urgent repairs.
hero_subhead: Electrical fault or power cut in Bedminster? We're here within the hour, day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs and fault-finding to full rewires and safety certificates, we handle every job with care and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Power cuts, tripped circuits, and faulty appliances fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to resolve most faults same day.

services.title: Fault-Finding & Diagnostics
services.desc: Flickering lights, burnt-out sockets, or strange smells? We trace the problem and fix it safely, with full diagnostic testing included.

services.title: Rewires & Full Installations
services.desc: Old wiring putting your home at risk? We plan and execute complete rewires with minimal disruption, all compliant with current Building Regulations.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Electrics
services.desc: Electrical issues with your heating system? We diagnose and repair control faults, thermostats, and immersion heater problems.

services.title: Safety Certificates & Testing
services.desc: EICR inspections and condition reports for landlords and home buyers. Fully compliant documentation included.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fuse boxes replaced with modern RCD-protected consumer units, improving safety and enabling you to add more circuits.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I got tired of cowboys overcharging my neighbours.
about_para_1: Bedminster Locksmith was founded in 2006 on a simple promise: honest pricing, skilled work, and no hidden costs. Over 18 years, we've built a reputation across Bristol by turning up on time, diagnosing problems properly, and delivering real solutions. Every electrician on our team is Part P certified and fully insured.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen before we sell. We explain what's wrong, what needs fixing, and what can wait — then we get on with the job without fuss. Whether it's a midnight power cut in Bedminster or a planned rewire across Bristol, we treat every home like it's our own.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Woke up to no power in half the house at 11pm. Rang Bedminster Locksmith and they were round in less than an hour. Turned out the consumer unit had a dodgy breaker. Fixed it properly, explained what went wrong, and didn't overcharge. Top service.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had an old fuse box that needed replacing. They did a full survey, walked me through the costs, and then did a brilliant job. Very tidy, no mess, and they even tested everything twice before they left. Would use them again in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: Christine D.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out on a Saturday afternoon. The lad was polite, got straight to work, and sorted it in about 45 minutes. Reasonable price considering it was a weekend. Will definitely be calling them for future jobs.
reviews.author: James P.
